messages:
leah: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a fast sweep of audit logging gaps across API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Want to triage the backlog and produce a customer-facing validation checklist by EOW. Who's available to help?
ashwin: I can take API gateway + auth. Do we have a current inventory of emitted events vs required schema? link: https://redwood-internal/notion/audit-inventory
jkeller: Runtime notes: we don't emit per-request model variant + cache-hit metadata today. Also missing runtime->kms key id for encrypted cache events.
maria: Billing: found gaps for invoice_view and billing_key_rotation events. Customers have asked for proof-of-access for finance audits.
ashwin: Proposed minimal schema fields to standardize (we should iterate):
```
{ "timestamp": "iso8601", "actor_id": "string", "actor_type": "user|service|sys", "action": "string", "resource": "string", "resource_id": "string", "outcome": "success|failure|denied", "request_id": "uuid", "region": "string", "kms_key_id": "string (optional)", "policy_hash": "string (optional)" }
```
ashwin: Adding `kms_key_id` lets us validate key use without leaking key material; `policy_hash` helps tie RBAC decisions to a specific policy snapshot.
sec-bot: audit-tracker: new issue created #SEC-412 for runtime KMS field addition (owner: jkeller).
bryan: For triage, recommend matrix: severity->customer-impact->regulatory-exposure->effort. High-priority: events required for SOC2/ISO (console auth, billing access, KMS ops). Customer-facing validation should include sample event payloads + queries.
leah: OK — suggested owners: API/auth = ashwin; runtime/KMS = jkeller; billing = maria; validation harness + docs = bryan. Timeline: initial PRs by Thu, validation harness smoke by Fri. Can we include a simple acceptance test per service?
ashwin: I'll add an automated test that emits a synthetic request and asserts the audit row has required fields (request_id, actor_id, outcome). Need test harness guidance on prod-read replica ingestion.
maria: I'll run billing checks against the staging replica and capture sample exported events for the customer examples. Will ping legal for data minimization approval. :thumbsup:
jkeller: One more item — RBAC changes: any role change should log `policy_hash` + `changed_by` + `change_delta` so we can replay decisions for audits. That's also high priority in our matrix.
leah: Great. I'll schedule a 15-min triage at 1400 today to lock owners and record acceptance criteria. Action items: ashwin create PR for schema + tests, jkeller PR for runtime + KMS, maria PR for billing events, bryan assemble customer validation doc. Ping me in-thread when PRs are up. :white_check_mark:
